episode_assignment.eligible_rows: exact frozen 0069 final-window rows for SOL|T4_LONG_SIDEWAYS at lead 10
episode_assignment.assignment_rule: assign each positive row to the earliest qualifying unique SOL T4_LONG_SIDEWAYS onset in chronological order
episode_assignment.negative_rows: never assigned to an onset and retained in every LOEO fold

loeo_fold_rule.fold_i: remove every positive warning row assigned to onset_i; retain every other eligible row unchanged

pass_gates.G5_cluster: at least one of P03/P08 has PR_AUC_LIFT>0 in every defined fold and median retention>=0.50 versus its own frozen 0069 lift

classification_rules.PASS_LOCKED_EPISODE_ROBUSTNESS_REPLICATI: valid execution and every G0-G5 gate passes
classification_rules.FAIL_LOCKED_EPISODE_ROBUSTNESS_REPLICATI: valid execution with sufficient defined support, but one or more scientific robustness gates G2-G5 fail
classification_rules.MEASUREMENT_INCONCLUSIVE_INSUFFICIENT_EP: identity/reproduction is valid but unique-onset support is not exactly 7 or any required LOEO fold/metric is mathematically undefined
classification_rules.INVALID_EXECUTION: source identity/hash/read-count, aggregate reproduction, deterministic assignment, fold-construction, persistence or exactly-once boundary drift

forbidden: architecture other than frozen P02 primary and P03/P08 dependent cluster
